observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s -L --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://make.fun/" -o /tmp/home.html -w "size=%{size_download}\n"; python3 -c "
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/home.html',errors='ignore').read()
links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href=\"(/[^\"#?]*)\"',s)))
print('links:',[l for l in links if not l.startswith('/_next')][:30])
body=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); body=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',body,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',body)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip()
print('\nTEKS:',t[:1200])
"
